mu_name_from: MuMain's MODEL_SERAPHIM_* (_enum.h: MODEL_BOOT + 49), loaded from Data/Player/BootMale50.bmd by the index-plus-one rule. MU's number 49; ours is *Male50.
why_this_one: The missing-gear audit, 2026-10-23: the last sets missing at drop levels 93-132, which Kanturu's monsters reach (the user: 'we need to build all kanturu weapons and armors'). Seraphim is the Fairy Elf's.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.75 and 0.95d have none).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names, lower-cased (an .OZT beside its .OZJ takes _t): white and red plate with winged trim; Item302_Helm.OZJ her face and bare skin, Item302_Helm.OZT the winged ornament (no cut: 0% under 128), Item302_Helm2.OZT her blond hair cut by its alpha (13% away).
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, the shading painted on, as the other sets.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, shallow for the gloss.
effects_note: MuMain's arms for MODEL_SERAPHIM_HELM/ARMOR (ZzzObject.cpp:7870-7893) draw one mesh only when the part HideSkin, which no worn part does; drawn as RenderBody. No glow, no chrome pass.
